## Notes

Eremite Games, Hooded Horse; early access October 2021; Windows 2023-12-08; consoles 2025-06-26; each run is a short settlement map; Reputation gauge versus Queen's Impatience; seven species, three per village; villagers leave when discontented; blight and corruption; seal fragments; storm destroys settlements and a new map is generated; over a million Steam copies by May 2024.
